messages:
ana_ml: Quick benchmark thread — ran end-to-end latency & throughput sweeps for Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B across instance classes (g5.12x, h100-8, a10g) and regions (us-west1, us-east1, eu-west1). Focus: 8k vs 32k context, rope vs rotary/GQA variants, and int8 quantized kernels. TL;DR up front: Mistral wins cost/latency at 8k on g5, Qwen shows memory pressure at 32k on g5 -> falling back to slower kernels; h100 gave best 32k latency but only with patched kernel for Qwen rope. More details below.
sam_infra: Nice. Can you paste the exact command and kernel flags you used so we can reproduce?
ana_ml: Sure — ran our bench harness with the following args:
```
./bench/run_bench.sh \
  --model {llama2-13b,mistral-7b,qwen-7b} \
  --instance {g5.12x,h100-8,a10g} \
  --region {us-west1,us-east1,eu-west1} \
  --context_len {8192,32768} \
  --quant int8 \
  --kernel_policy {auto,rope-compat,kv-gqa}
```
ana_ml: Kernel notes: "auto" lets runtime pick kernels; "rope-compat" forces legacy rope kernels; "kv-gqa" enables our experimental GQA-optimized KV cache kernels.
mike_bench: Results snapshot (median p50 latency, ms) — quick ascii table from bench-bot:
bench-bot: 
```
Model     | Instance | Context | kernel     | region    | p50_lat_ms | tps
---------------------------------------------------------------
Mistral7B | g5.12x   | 8k      | auto       | us-west1  | 210        | 45
Llama13B  | g5.12x   | 8k      | auto       | us-west1  | 260        | 36
Qwen7B    | g5.12x   | 8k      | auto       | us-west1  | 300        | 30
Mistral7B | h100-8   | 32k     | kv-gqa     | us-east1  | 480        | 28
Llama13B  | h100-8   | 32k     | rope-compat| us-east1  | 520        | 25
Qwen7B    | g5.12x   | 32k     | auto       | us-west1  | 1200       | 6  <-- kernel fallback observed
Qwen7B    | h100-8   | 32k     | rope-patch | eu-west1  | 540        | 26
```
ana_ml: The Qwen/g5 32k row is the interesting one — the runtime fell back from our fast fused KV kernels to a generic attention kernel due to a rope-handling mismatch in the g5 CUDA kernel for qwen weight layout. That caused memory copies and dropped throughput.
katie_research: Did you try int8 vs fp16 on that Qwen/g5 32k case? Might be quantization + kernel interaction.
ana_ml: Yes. int8 w/ our usual quant pipeline reduced memory footprint but didn't prevent the fallback. On g5 the fallback path is selected before quant-decisions because the kernel compatibility check runs on op layout, not data type.
mike_bench: Repro snippet for the failing case:
```
# reproduce
python run_inference.py \
  --model qwen-7b --weights-layout gated_attn --context 32768 \
  --device cuda:g5 --kernel_policy auto --trace kernel_check
```
# trace output (shortened)
KERNEL_CHECK: fused_kv_qwen: incompatible_layout -> fallback_generic_attention
KV_CACHE: memcopy 3.2GB
```
sam_infra: Good catch. Two paths: 1) add a layout shim in runtime to make g5 kernel accept Qwen layout, 2) ship Qwen weight-conversion at model onboarding to match legacy rope layout. Which is faster to ship?
ana_ml: For immediate relief, weight conversion as part of model onboarding is quickest (few hours). Longer term, adding a layout acceptance shim in the runtime avoids conversions but needs careful perf testing (1-2 sprints).
katie_research: Any quality regressions after int8 quant with kv-gqa kernels? We should verify perplexity and a curated eval set (dialog + codegen slices) before recommending.
mike_bench: Ran evals: int8 + kv-gqa on Mistral and Llama — small BLEU/ROUGE delta <0.8% on our eval set. Qwen int8 had a bigger delta (~2.1%) on codegen tests. I can share per-prompt diffs.
ana_ml: Notes for capacity sizing: Mistral on g5 at 8k gives best tokens/sec per dollar. For 32k, h100 is most cost-effective despite higher per-hour cost due to kernel efficiency and more stable memory profile.
sam_infra: For us-east1 vs eu-west1 differences — we saw ~5-8% higher latency in eu-west1 on average, likely instance packing/network. Nothing model-specific.
bench-bot: Uploaded full CSVs to s3://redwood-bench/q1/1769012345-qwen-mistral-llama-sweep.csv

ana_ml: Action items:
- mike_bench: attach per-prompt diffs & eval artifacts to the ticket (#ML-1123)
- sam_infra: quick onboard weight-conversion step for Qwen on g5 (hotfix)
- katie_research: run full eval suite on int8+kv-gqa for Qwen before we enable in prod
- infra/product: decide whether to enable auto-weight-conversion during onboarding (opt-in)

sam_infra: I'll create the hotfix PR and schedule a canary rollout in us-west1.
mike_bench: Adding perf dashboards for these rows (by kernel_policy) so we can watch regressions.
ana_ml: Thanks all. If anyone wants raw logs or the bench harness config, ping me and I'll drop the tarball here. :rocket:
